name: [NEW SUIT] Web Rush
desc:
Early development, expect lots of bugs, come join the server for announcements! 🕷️

Defeat thugs and swing to receive cash, use cash to buy new suits!

PC Controls:
[Left Click] Attack
[X] Air Tricks
[Shift / Right Click] Zip to Point / (Hold) Swing
[Ctrl] Dodge
[C] Dive
[Space] (In air) Web Zip
[V] Camera Lock
